newsitem.title: DUBAI: Airport at Iran's Qeshm island free zone opens.
newsitem.headline: Airport at Iran's Qeshm island free zone opens.

text.p: A new airport in Iran's Qeshm island free zone has opened and will initially receive three flights a week from Tehran, the official news agency IRNA reported on Monday.

"Following the completion of construction operations and the installation of navigational equipment, Qeshm airport formally went into operation on Sunday with the landing of a flight from Tehran," it said.
"Three weekly flights will link Tehran with Qeshm island every Sunday, Tuesday and Thursday. The airport will gradually expand and will start flights to other cities," it added.

The free zone, one of three Iran set up in 1989 to attract foreign investment, has so far attracted $100 million although it has a capacity for investments worth $4 billion. The airport has a 4.5 km runway. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
